subject: Post-call: Context window & pricing clarifications
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@clearspan.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Context window & pricing clarifications

Mike — thanks for taking the call this morning. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a narrow pilot proposal. Notes below reflect how we heard your team describe the workload; please correct any inaccuracies.

Summary of your use cases
- Primary: clinical summarization of patient-provider conversations and visit notes (batch + on-demand).
- Secondary: patient-facing summaries and automated care-plan generation (longer completions).
- Expected production start: Q1 2027 pilot -> phased roll into pilot group in Q2.

Context & output profiling (what we captured)
- Avg prompt tokens (all calls + context provided): ~340 tokens (median ~300).
- Avg completion tokens (summaries): ~1,720 tokens (std dev ~900).
- Mix: ~88% of calls fit comfortably in an 8k context window (short history + transcript chunking).
  - ~10% require 32k due to multi-encounter threads; these are mostly enterprise care-coordination cases.
  - ~2% fall into the 128k category (rare, multi-session retrospective investigations).
- Expected monthly token volume (initial pilot cohort): ~150,000,000 tokens / month (total tokens = prompts + completions).

Budget & target pricing you mentioned
- You indicated a target in the ballpark of $700–$950 per 1M tokens for the pilot, with a preferred target of ~$800/1M.

Questions / asks from our side
1) Can you confirm the % split above (8k / 32k / 128k) and the 150M/month pilot volume? If those change materially we will re-run the unit-econ.
2) Any procurement constraints we should know about (PO vs SOW, standard terms that block usage-based billing)?
3) Do you need residency/SOC2 evidence in the pilot contract? You flagged this on the call but we want the exact ask.

Proposed immediate next step
- If you confirm the numbers above, we will send a concise 3-week pilot SOW that includes:
  - 10M token trial bucket (exercisable within a 3-week window)
  - Pilot price: draft range we plan to propose based on today's call (see attached unit-econ summary).
  - Success criteria (latency under 600ms p50 on 8k path, accuracy regressions <2% on sampled evals, integration checklist items).

Attachments: clearspan_context_profile_v1.csv (token breakdown by endpoint), redwood_pricing_pilot_v1.pdf (draft unit-econ + pricing bands).

Thanks — I’ll hold on drafting the SOW until you confirm the numbers below.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM serving

From: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@clearspan.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clearspan Procurement <procurement@clearspan.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context window & pricing clarifications

Olga — thanks for the thorough recap, this aligns well with what we discussed. Confirmations and a couple clarifications below.

Confirmations
- Avg prompt: we measure ~320–360 tokens depending on whether we include prepopulated template fields; 340 on average is fine.
- Avg completion: our production summaries trend ~1,600–1,900 tokens — 1,720 is a solid representative number.
- Volume: the pilot cohort is expected to hit ~150M tokens/month (this is for 2,500 active users across three clinics).
- Mix: we concur with the split (approx 88% 8k / 10% 32k / 2% 128k).

Procurement & security
- Procurement prefers a short SOW + PO for pilots — our legal team can do a quick review but asks that any long-term SLA clauses are optional for the pilot.
- We will need SOC2 Type II report and a statement on data residency (US-based). For pilot purposes we can accept encrypted transit + agreed retention.

Budget & pricing
- We are comfortable with a pilot target near $800/1M tokens as discussed; our procurement team has given a flexible range of $700–$950/1M depending on commitment and SLA.

Next asks from our side
- Please send the 3-week pilot SOW and the exact pricing bands you propose (line items for 8k/32k/128k tiers if there are different unit economics).
- If you can include an example DocuSign link or a stub SOW for PO, that will speed procurement.

Thanks — happy to proceed once we have the SOW.

—Mike
Mike Jackson
Head of Product, Clearspan Health
mike.jackson@clearspan.com | (206) 555-0188

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context window & pricing clarifications (internal)

O — quick internal note on unit-econ and a recommended pilot quote. I ran the numbers off the 150M/month pilot signal and the mix Olga captured. Key assumptions below:

Assumptions
- Model execution cost (hosted, includes GPU + infra) averaged to $0.22 per 1k tokens for 8k path; 32k is ~1.35x cost; 128k is ~3.5x cost.
- Estimated support/ingestion + monitoring overhead: $0.05 per 1k tokens.
- Desired gross margin target for pilot: 55–60% (we want headroom for Dedicated upsell later).

Quick unit-econ (per 1M tokens)
- 8k path (baseline): infra+ops ~ $270 / 1M tokens; target retail price to hit 60% margin ~ $675 / 1M tokens.
- 32k path: infra ~ $365 / 1M tokens; target retail price ~ $910 / 1M tokens.
- 128k path: infra ~ $945 / 1M tokens; target retail price ~ $2,360 / 1M tokens.

Pilot recommendation (single blended pilot price to keep procurement simple)
- Offer a blended pilot rate of $775 / 1M tokens for the 10M trial bucket (blended using the 88/10/2 split).
- Include: 30% overage credit for any unused tokens rolled into a second short trial extension (one-time), and a clear uplift table if they convert to an annual committed plan.
- Attach the pilot SOW draft and the unit-econ spreadsheet.

If Marissa and I are aligned we can push the SOW + DocuSign stub to Mike. The $775 hits the middle of their $700–$950 band and preserves our target margin.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context window & pricing clarifications

Mike / procurement — appreciate the quick confirmation on numbers. Attached is a concise pilot SOW and pricing proposal (see attached PDF & embedded unit-econ). Highlights below: 

Pilot offer (concise)
- Pilot period: 3 weeks from SOW signature.
- Trial bucket: 10,000,000 tokens (prompts + completions).
- Blended pilot rate: $775 per 1M tokens (applies across 8k/32k/128k mix; we will use confirmed mix to calculate actual invoice).
- Credits: 30% unused-token rollover credit if pilot utilization <70% and they elect a second trial extension within 30 days.
- Success criteria: latency p50 < 600ms on 8k path, sample-quality pass rate >= 95% on agreed prompt set, integration checklist items completed.

Compliance & procurement
- SOC2 Type II attestation and US data residency statement included as attachments; for pilot we will use encrypted transit + 14-day retention default unless you request otherwise.
- We will publish a short SOW (attached) that procurement can PO against; DocuSign stub link included below.

Next steps
1) Procurement: review attached SOW and indicate whether PO or SOW is preferred.
2) Legal (if needed): quick review of the one-page SOW (we’ve kept pilot terms limited).
3) Sign + kickoff: once signed, we’ll open the 10M token bucket and target a 72-hour integration window for the first set of endpoints.

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HP-2026-CLSP-0921
- DocuSign stub: https://www.docusign.net/some-doc-link/CLSP-pilot
- Attachments: clearspan_context_profile_v1.csv, redwood_pricing_pilot_v1.pdf, pilot_sow_draft.docx

If this looks reasonable I’ll route the DocuSign and loop in Solutions Eng for kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Clearspan running on Redwood.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
